aur:omarchy-games-menu.name: Games Menu
aur:omarchy-games-menu.summary: Does not start on the phone: [32m  INFO[0m: Configuration Loaded

aur:omarchy-imageview.name: Omarchy Image Viewer
aur:omarchy-imageview.summary: The header and sort menu fit the narrow screen and are easy to tap, but the app only ever shows an empty '0 images' grid, so its main browsing view was never seen in use.

aur:omawrite.name: Omawrite
notes: Some buttons are small for a finger
Some of it runs off the edge
aur:omawrite.summary: The editor fills a narrow screen well, but the open-file dialog is wider than the phone, so its sidebar is cut off on the left and its file list runs past the right edge.

aur:omcalc-git.name: Calculator (OM)
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
Made for a keyboard: nothing to tap
aur:omcalc-git.summary: The window is wider than the phone, so the right side of the input, the history panel and the hint line are cut off. There are also no buttons to tap, because the keypad and clearing only work through keyboard shortcuts.

aur:osmin.description: Satellite Navigator & Tracker On-Road/Off-Road for Mobile
aur:osmin.name: osmin
aur:osmin.summary: Every screen reached, from the welcome page to the region and country download lists, is laid out in a single column that fits the narrow phone screen, with large rows that are easy to tap.

aur:overskride.description: A simple yet powerful bluetooth app!
aur:overskride.name: Overskride
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:overskride.summary: The window is wider than the phone screen, so the right side is cut off: the switches, the 'Choose' button and the descriptions are hidden, and the sidebar button never opens the device list.

aur:pachub.name: PacHub
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:pachub.summary: A fixed desktop sidebar takes up half the phone's width, so the package list, search field, headings and footer are cut off at the right edge, and the package detail pane never appears.

aur:packet.name: Packet
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:packet.summary: The home screen fits the phone well, but the file picker behind 'Add Files' is a desktop dialog with no sidebar, no Cancel or Open buttons, and no response to taps, so you can't add a file.

aur:parlatype.name: Parlatype
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:parlatype.summary: The main window runs off the right edge, cutting off the speed control, and the Open Audio File dialog is wider than the screen, so its sidebar, file list and Open/Cancel buttons are off-screen and no file can be chosen.

aur:passes.name: Passes
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:passes.summary: The welcome screen fits the phone well, but the file picker needed to import a pass is wider than the screen, so its sidebar, folder names and Cancel/Open buttons are cut off and no pass could be opened.

aur:picplanner.name: PicPlanner
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:picplanner.summary: The map and the sun, moon and Milky Way panel fit the narrow screen well, but the About/Credits dialog is wider than the phone and gets cut off on the left, clipping its back button and headings.

aur:pigment.description: Extract color palettes from your images
aur:pigment.name: Pigment
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:pigment.summary: The opening screen fits the phone well, but the image file chooser you need to load a picture is wider than the screen: file and folder names are cut off on the left, and its Cancel and Open buttons are out of reach, so you can't pick a photo.

aur:pinit.description: Pin portable apps to the launcher
aur:pinit.name: Pin It!
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:pinit.summary: The main list fits the phone. The edit screen is wider than the display, so the Save button, the right side of the form fields and their file-picker buttons are cut off at the right edge.

aur:pins-git.name: Pins
aur:pins-git.summary: Pins fits the narrow screen well, with a three-column grid of pins and a single-column editor that are easy to use by touch; the only flaw is that some longer pin names in the grid are cut short with an ellipsis.

aur:pipecontrol.description: Pipewire control GUI program in Qt (Kirigami2)
aur:pipecontrol.name: PipeControl
aur:pipecontrol.summary: Does not start on the phone.

aur:pipeline-gtk.name: Pipeline
aur:pipeline-gtk.summary: The app is built for a narrow screen: the feed, sidebar, menu and Preferences all fit the phone's width and scroll properly, and the only flaw shown is the cut-off "More Information" button on the opening privacy notice.

aur:plattenalbum.name: Plattenalbum
aur:plattenalbum.summary: Every screen reached, from the welcome screen to the setup and manual-connection bottom sheets, fits the narrow phone screen with large touch-friendly buttons and nothing cut off.

aur:powersupply.description: Graphical power_supply status tool for Linux mobile platforms
aur:powersupply.name: Powersupply
aur:powersupply.summary: Does not start on the phone: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'gi.repository'

aur:quick-lookup.name: Quick Lookup
aur:quick-lookup.summary: Quick Lookup fits the narrow phone screen well: the search bar, the definitions, the tappable links and the language picker all stay in view and are easy to use by touch.

aur:rclone-shuttle.name: Rclone Shuttle
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:rclone-shuttle.summary: The main screen and its menu fit a phone well, but the first-run warning dialog is wider than the screen and runs slightly off the left edge, though its text and buttons can still be read and tapped.

aur:recorder.name: Recorder
aur:recorder.summary: Everything fits the narrow screen and is easy to tap, including the menu and dialogs, but the crowded header cuts the title down to "Rec…" and the main list stays empty.

aur:riff-client.description: Native Spotify client for the GNOME desktop
aur:riff-client.name: Riff
aur:riff-client.summary: Riff adapts well to the phone: the sidebar becomes a full-screen list, grids fall back to a single column, the sort popover fits on screen and the player bar has large, finger-sized controls.

aur:rustconn.name: RustConn
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:rustconn.summary: The welcome screen and the SSH form fit the phone, but the New Connection type picker is wider than the screen, so its title and third column of connection types are cut off at the right edge.

aur:sidemark.description: View and annotate PDF files with markdown notes
aur:sidemark.name: Sidemark
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:sidemark.summary: The toolbar fits, but the page runs off the right edge, the tooltip text is cut off, the hamburger menu didn't open when tapped, and the tool popover stayed open after several attempts to close it, so it is hard to use by touch.

aur:simple-scan-linuxmint.description: Make a digital copy of your photos and documents
aur:simple-scan-linuxmint.name: Document Scanner
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:simple-scan-linuxmint.summary: The main window and its menu fit the narrow screen, but the Preferences dialog is wider than the phone, so its left edge and section headings are cut off.

aur:smile.description: An emoji picker with custom tags support
aur:smile.name: Smile
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:smile.summary: The emoji grid and its category bar fit the narrow screen well, but the Preferences window is wider than the phone and cut off on the left, and custom tags, the app's key feature, can only be made with the Alt+T keyboard shortcut.

aur:solitaire.name: Solitaire
aur:solitaire.summary: The game list, the full Klondike board, the menu and the Scores sheet all fit the narrow screen, and cards can be moved by tapping them.

aur:spedread.name: Spedread
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:spedread.summary: The window is wider than the phone, so the right side is cut off: pasted text runs past the edge mid-word, the play bar and the end of the header are clipped, and the word being read sits off-centre.

aur:speedofsound.description: Voice typing for the Linux desktop
aur:speedofsound.name: Speed of Sound
aur:speedofsound.summary: Does not start on the phone: 	at kotlinx.coroutines.scheduling.CoroutineScheduler$Worker.run(CoroutineScheduler.kt:704)

aur:sticky-notes.name: Sticky Notes
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:sticky-notes.summary: The note list and note editor fit the narrow screen well and are easy to use by touch, but the About and Credits dialogs run off the top of the screen, hiding their close and back buttons.

aur:swash.description: Screenshot annotator and lightweight image editor
aur:swash.name: Swash
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:swash.summary: The main screen fits the phone, but the Open image file chooser is wider than the screen, so its sidebar, file names and buttons are cut off and no image could be opened.

aur:sysex-controls.description: Linux alternative to the MIDI Control Center software
aur:sysex-controls.name: SysEx Controls
aur:sysex-controls.summary: Every screen reached (the main screen, the menu, About and Shortcuts) fits the narrow phone width, with nothing cut off and controls big enough to tap.

aur:tangara-companion.description: Companion app for Cool Tech Zone Tangara
aur:tangara-companion.name: Tangara Companion
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:tangara-companion.summary: A fixed sidebar takes up the left half of the screen, so the logo and the "connect your Tangara" instructions run off the right edge and nothing the user taps changes that.

aur:textsnatcher.description: Snatch Text with just a Drag
aur:textsnatcher.name: TextSnatcher
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:textsnatcher.summary: The main screen and the image-source menu fit a phone well, but the file picker it opens runs past both screen edges and shows no sidebar, file names or Open/Cancel buttons, so you can't choose a file.

aur:thiefmd.name: ThiefMD
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:thiefmd.summary: The welcome wizard is too wide for the phone, so its title and the right side of every page are cut off, and the library page's 'Add to Library' button never opened a folder chooser, which left the user stuck before reaching the editor.

aur:timetable.name: Timetable
aur:timetable.summary: Does not start on the phone: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cairo'

aur:tomatillo.name: Tomatillo
aur:tomatillo.summary: Does not start on the phone: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'gi.repository'

aur:tonearm.description: Tonearm is a GTK client for TIDAL written in GoLang.
aur:tonearm.name: Tonearm
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:tonearm.summary: The player panel fits, but the main library pages are wider than the phone: the navigation tabs, error text, featured row and genre buttons all run off the right edge, and the main content shows only as a clipped sliver next to the player.

aur:touche.name: Touché
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:touche.summary: The app keeps its desktop two-pane layout on the phone, so the applications sidebar takes up most of the width and pushes the gesture settings off the right edge, where they can't be read or reached.

aur:transistor-git.name: Transistor
aur:transistor-git.summary: Does not start on the phone.

aur:tributary.name: Tributary
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:tributary.summary: The fixed sidebar takes half the width, so the track list, the player's seek bar and the location dialog are cut off at the right edge of the phone screen.

aur:tundra.name: Tundra
aur:tundra.summary: The only screen reached is a sign-in screen that fits the narrow phone width cleanly, with a full-width Sign in button that is easy to tap.

aur:ultimate-tic-tac-toe-git.description: Ultimate Tic Tac Toe - GTK4/libadwaita Python game
aur:ultimate-tic-tac-toe-git.name: Ultimate Tic Tac Toe
notes: Some buttons are small for a finger
aur:ultimate-tic-tac-toe-git.summary: The whole 9x9 board, the menu and the scrolling rules sheet all fit the narrow screen, though the board's cells are only about 30 px wide, a little small for a fingertip.

aur:vermouth.description: Native, Windows, and retro game launcher for Linux
aur:vermouth.name: Vermouth
notes: Some buttons are small for a finger
Some of it runs off the edge
aur:vermouth.summary: The main library screen fits the phone's width, but the bottom toolbar is squeezed into blank, unlabeled buttons with a slider running off the right edge, so the 'Add App/Game' button can't be found, and the welcome screen's runtime field and umu-launcher text also run off the right side.

aur:watchmate.description: Sync and integrate with PineTime smart watch
aur:watchmate.name: Watchmate
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:watchmate.summary: The main, Devices and Settings screens fit the narrow phone screen and are easy to use by touch, but the About dialog is slightly too wide, so its left edge is cut off, though everything in it can still be read and tapped.

aur:wattage.name: Wattage
aur:wattage.summary: Wattage fits the phone's narrow screen: its device list slides over the main view as a panel, and the header buttons and menu are all within reach and easy to tap.

aur:waytator.description: Screenshot annotator and lightweight image editor
aur:waytator.name: Waytator
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:waytator.summary: The welcome screen fits, but the image-opening dialog is wider than the phone, so its left side runs off the screen and folder names are cut off to fragments like 'nts' and 'ads', leaving no sensible way to pick a photo.

aur:whatip.name: What IP
aur:whatip.summary: Every screen, the consent dialog and Preferences fit the phone's width and are easy to tap, but the second and third tab labels are cut down to "…" in the header.

aur:whisp.description: A minimalist note taking widget application
aur:whisp.name: Whisp
aur:whisp.summary: Whisp fits the narrow screen: the note wraps cleanly, the header icons are big enough to tap and the menu popover stays on screen, but it has no visible button for making a new note or moving between notes, only swipes and keyboard shortcuts.

aur:winkel.description: A metronome that follows your Omarchy theme
aur:winkel.name: Winkel
notes: Some buttons are small for a finger
aur:winkel.summary: The metronome fits the narrow screen and its pickers show in full and work by touch, but the plus and minus buttons and the bottom row of buttons are a little small for a finger.

aur:wombat.description: High-precision scientific calculator with full unit support, powered by Numbat
aur:wombat.name: Wombat
notes: Some buttons are small for a finger
aur:wombat.summary: Everything fits the narrow screen and works by touch, including the input row, the calculator keys and the Units, Constants and Functions browsers; only the rows in the Functions browser are tight to tap, and some output lines wrap awkwardly.

aur:word-sys-pdf-editor.description: A simple and user-friendly PDF Editor
aur:word-sys-pdf-editor.name: word-sys's PDF Editor
notes: Some of it runs off the edge
aur:word-sys-pdf-editor.summary: The editor is wider than the phone, so the page canvas, zoom controls and title run off the right edge, and the Save dialog is clipped on both sides, which leaves its Save button out of reach.
